description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - elected New Vice Chairman in the meeting Convened On 07.09.2021 at 10.00 am at Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election results for a local government position (Chairman of Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. It specifically deals with electoral processes and declarations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes. The content focuses on the electoral outcome rather than government appointments or structural changes.
